metadata.description: Claude Code session state on an AWTRIX NG LED matrix panel, over USB serial

plugins.name: awtrix-panel
plugins.description: Shows whether Claude Code is working, waiting or asking, plus context usage and quota, on a 32x8 LED panel. Needs a Ulanzi TC001 (or any AWTRIX NG board) running the serial-control firmware, and pixelwire to drive it.
